d:
The Trail Blazers defeated the Suns, 132-119 tonight in Phoenix. Damian Lillard finished with a team-high 25 points along with 5 assists and 3 rebounds for the Trail Blazers, while Donovan Clingan tallied 24 points, 3 blocks and 11 rebounds in the game. Devin Booker recorded 33 points, 2 assists and 2 three pointers. The Trail Blazers improve their record to 6-1 with the win, while the Suns fall to 1-5 for the season.
